f = open('article.txt', 'r', encoding='utf-8')
text = f.read().lower()
f.close()
for ch in '.,!?;:':
    text = text.replace(ch, ' ')
words = text.split()
d = {}
for w in words:
    d[w] = d.get(w, 0) + 1
print('不同单词数:', len(d))
print('the 出现次数:', d.get('the', 0))

items.ref:
import random
random.seed(5)
target = random.randint(1, 100)
cnt = 0
while True:
    g = int(input())
    cnt = cnt + 1
    if g > target:
        print('猜大了')
    elif g < target:
        print('猜小了')
    else:

        break
